@DIR@/M
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- M/M-rt/src/com/a/Ctl.java --
package com.a;
class Ctl {
  static class Cfg { int a; long b; double c = SCALE * 2; int d; }
}
-- M/M-rt/src/com/a/BCtl.java --
package com.a;
@NiagaraType
// @NiagaraProperty(name = "d", type = "int", defaultValue = "5")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "a", type = "BStatusNumeric", defaultValue = "new BStatusNumeric()")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "b", type = "BRelTime", defaultValue = "BRelTime.makeSeconds(5)")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "c", type = "double", defaultValue = "4")
public class BCtl extends BComponent {
  void cycle(Ctl.Cfg cfg) {
    cfg.a = getA().getValue();
    cfg.b = getB().getMillis() / 1000 * 0 + compute();
    cfg.c = getC();
    cfg.d = getD();
  }
}
